paite: David in, "Jonathan ziak a hehpihna ka latsak theihna ding in Saul inkote lak a mi om lai a-om hia?" achi hi.
heading: David Leh Mephibosheth

paite: Saul inkote sikha khat amin Ziba a-om hi. David kiang a hoh ding in asam uhi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Ziba na hi hia?" achi a; ama'n, "Na sikha amah ka hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n, "Pathian hehpihna ka latsak theihna ding in Saul inkote lak a mi om lai om lou uhia?" achi hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Jonathan in tapa khat anei lai a, amah khebai ahi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Koi a om ahia?" achi hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, Lo-debar ah Amiel tapa Makir inn ah a-om," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa David in mi asawl a, Lo-debar a pan Ammiel tapa Makir inn a pan mi ava pisak hi.
David kiang ah Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth ahong hi. Amai a lei si in zahtakna apia hi. David in, "Mephibosheth," achi a; ama'n, "En in, na sikha," chi in adawng hi.
David in akiang ah, “Lau ke'n. Na pa Jonathan ziak in hehpihna ka hon musak ngeingei ding. Na pu Saul gam tengteng ka hon pe nawn dia, ka dohkan ah an na ne gige ding," achi hi.
Huchi in akun a, "Ui sisa bang lel na hon limsak, kei na sikha bang ka hi a?" achi hi.
Kumpipa'n Saul sikha Ziba asam a, akiang ah, "Saul thil neih tengteng leh a-inkote thil tengteng na pu tapa ka pe vek hi.

Amah a ding in lei na lehsak dia, nang leh na tapate leh na sikhate teng in na pu tapa in nek ding aneihtheihna ding in na sepkhiakte na hon la ding. Na pu tapa Mephibosheth in bel ka dohkan ah an a-um gige ding," achi hi. Ziba in tapa sawm-le-nga leh sikha sawmnih anei hi.

Huchi in Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa ka toupa'n asikha thu apiak bang zel in na sikha in ahih ding," achi hi. Kumpipa'n, "Mephibosheth in ka dohkan ah kumpipa tapa bang in an a-um ding," achi hi.
Mephibosheth in tapa naupang anei a, amin Mika ahi. Ziba inn a om tengteng Mephibosheth sikhate ahi uh.
Huchi in kumpipa dohkan a an a-um gige ziak in Jerusalem ah Mephibosheth atengta hi; amah akhe lang tuak bai ahi.
